restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7, E1.c1 lies in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098, Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), and t is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1; trials with t = 0 are skipped. Only outer steps that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 (share 2^-9.9782) run the solver. It walks the one path of the static slot J, 18 fresh bits naming a row, a seed of a[20] and the free bits of h (proof.md 18.2, 18.3), with no guard, no pre-check and no guard certificate, and certifies at most one trial: each listed success owns exactly one of 2^18 slots (Lemma S18), so a step certifies one with probability exactly N/2^18. Heuristic part: 2^87.460 outer steps of 2^21 trials give a collision with probability at least 0.39 under H1' and H4'', with the stated advice fixed (proof.md Lemma ADV).

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) per unit, on a 64-register load/store machine with immediate constants; each fetch of a memory word costs one load. Outer steps run seven to a batch in lean packed 36-bit lanes: 426 units per batch (nine fresh words), 35 per lane whose test-(2) mask meets S (its Q path), and 512 + 21,248 per passing outer step for its rebuild, the slot decode, the one path and the certificate of its root (proof.md 18.6): proved upper allowances of a specified layout, not measured or implemented counts. No sorting, no lookup by value, no table that grows with the trials. The run halts with failure when the test-(2) or pass count exceeds its budget, or after RUN_BATCHES batches; each row is charged at its budget plus one, and no mean of a work count is used.

Randomized by nine fresh uniform 256-bit words per batch of seven outer steps; each outer step reads its own disjoint bits, its slot J from bits 36i to 36i+17 of the ninth word (Lemmas PL, PL9). Success 0.39 holds only under H1' (a mean rate, no dependence clause) and H4'' (two budget clauses for this run), with the stated advice fixed (proof.md Lemma ADV); the time bound has no premise and charges the selection procedure SEL at its cap (proof.md 12.2). The factor 98,937,639,497 in H1' is five sevenths of the model count of S on the class, rounded down, and is not measured by the organizer-run experiments, which run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11). No full 2-round collision is exhibited. The submitted program is the program of the 32-slot variant (proof.md 9.8, Section 13), unchanged: it runs that variant on the root instance only and does not run the 18-bit path of Section 18, which no program of this package implements.

Fixed nonuniform advice, 73 bytes (proof.md 12.1): six 32-bit constants, eta, the beta* cube (beta*, mask, value), the seven tau values and eps of the filter's automata and the mask of S. No step of the run selects them; the success bound uses only properties of them that proof.md checks exactly (Lemma ADV), and no premise concerns what a selection procedure returns. preprocessing_log2 55, included in time_log2, is the charge of the selection procedure SEL of proof.md 12.2 that found them: 116 solver runs capped at 2^56 operations each, one count per model capped at 2^52 + 2^10, and the choice of S capped at 2^50, in all S_old = 8,882,224,365,081,579,520 operations, below 2^62.946, below 2^54.198 units. The cap holds by construction, since every run halts at its cap; SEL is not a premise. memory_log2_bytes 44 covers, held at once, the two output messages (each below 2^42 bytes), the search with its code (below 2^29) and every run of SEL (below 2^34 + 2^20). No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical; a mean rate only. Over the run's RUN_STEPS independent outer steps (eight uniform 256-bit words each, Lemma PL), let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step (t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome in S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0, six outcomes of beta*; Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1), counted over all of Q* whether or not the outer step passes the filter. Rate: E[N_o] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(5 * 138,512,695,296 / 7) = 98,937,639,497, about 2^-91.474 (just under five sevenths of the conditional model rate of Lemma S1 for S). Nothing else is assumed about N_o: no clause on how the listed good trials of one outer step depend on each other and no bound on its factorial ratio rho. The search certifies at most one trial per passing outer step, the one of the static slot J named by 18 fresh bits of a ninth word, and every listed good trial of a step owns exactly one of 2^18 slots, so the certified count N_18 is 0 or 1 with E[N_18] = E[N_o] / 2^18 exactly, whatever the joint law of the trials (Lemmas FP and S18); with RUN_STEPS = ceil(0.49512 * 2^18 * 2^128 / (FACTOR (2^21 - 1))) the run fails to certify a trial with probability at most exp(-0.49512) (proof.md 18.5). Lemma S18 uses no guard, no pre-check and no guard certificate. The rate is declared anew for the whole class and S. By Lemma F every listed good trial lies in an outer step that passes the filter, and the solver runs in every passing step, so N_o is the count Lemma S18 thins.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 18: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 a member of the whole class of eta (524,288 values, Lemma Q) drawn with the outer words from the run's fresh 256-bit words (seven outer steps to a batch, each on its own disjoint bits, Lemma PL), E1.c1 drawn from the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 in every trial, t solved per trial and t = 0 skipped. N_o counts all of Q* in every outer step and only the six outcomes of S; the clause concerns its mean only. The ninth word, the slots and the one path (proof.md 18.1 to 18.3) do not change N_o.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's exact count, in integer arithmetic under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class, of the part of beta* on the class carried by the six outcomes of S (67,633,152 = 1,032 * 2^16 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 of the class; the counting program and its output are printed in Section 17), times 2^11 for drawing E1.c1 from the cube (Lemma S1), taken at five sevenths, rounded down. The filter does not change the count (Lemma F), and the 18-bit slots keep exactly 2^-18 of the mean (Lemma S18), which the run length pays. Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness: a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials in 2^25 passing outer steps, with a sub-class control of the same size, in which every measured quantity matches the exact model within 1.5 clustered standard errors, among them the E1 rate on the whole class of the seven outcomes of entry 59f8915e, 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model (13,595 events); that counter covered the seven together, so the E1 event of S is a sub-event of the measured event (52/53 of it in the model) and was not counted on its own; 2^43 real trials inside passing outer steps of the seven-outcome filter on the sub-class, listed E1 outcome 0.979 +- 0.022 of its value; and a reduced-width (8-bit) end-to-end run of complete messages, with no sub-class and no rule, in which the counter arrangement found 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted. The joint 128-bit event itself, about 2^-91 per trial, is not measured at 32 bits.
heuristics.limitations: The factor 98,937,639,497 is assumed (five sevenths of the model count of the six outcomes of S on the class, rounded down). The premise of entry 26ebba63 was for the sub-class with rule A and is not inherited; the whole-class mean of N_o for S is declared, not proved. The organizer-run experiments run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11) and measure neither the factor nor the counter half-collision, which no digest experiment can show. The transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is partly proved (Lemmas S1-S5, S9) and partly assumed; how much of the success mass the member with t = 0 carries is not proved. The whole-class graphics-card run measures the E1 side of the seven outcomes together and the filter, not the six of S on their own, not the E3 side nor the joint event. The one path and its cap of 21,248 are proved allowances; no program of this package runs the 18-bit path, and the submitted program runs the 32-slot variant on the root instance only.

heuristics.statement: Supporting. Two count-budget clauses for the run of this package, with one failure allowance for their union: with probability at least 0.9995 over the coins both hold, so no budget halts the run. (a) Pass budget: at most PASS_BUDGET = 224,234,042,441,127,612,340,698 outer steps pass the filter for S (nominal share pi = 279,070,422,111 / 2^48 = 2^-9.9782). (b) Lean test-(2) budget: at most E_BUDGET = 12,307,082,210,874,577,473,443,429 lanes have a test-(2) mask meeting S and run the Q path (nominal share 233,715,456 / 2^32 = 2^-4.1998). Each budget is ceil(17/16 * RUN_STEPS * share) with RUN_STEPS = 212,862,221,476,457,396,553,214,581. These are two of the three clauses of H4' of the 32-slot variant (proof.md 10.3) stated for this run, 2^13 times longer: a tail bound for a run of fixed length does not by itself extend to a longer one. The third clause, the quarter share of the pre-check, is not needed: the 18-bit path has no pre-check (proof.md 18.1). Reaching a budget halts with failure; the time bound charges each budget plus one. The ninth word adds no clause: neither count reads it.
heuristics.scope: The counts N_E and N_2 of proof.md 10.3 over the RUN_STEPS outer steps of step 1' of proof.md 18.1, with Y4 drawn from the whole class: each is binomial over independent outer steps (Lemma PL) with the sampler's probability of its indicator; the two indicators of one outer step may depend on each other in any way, and neither depends on the slot J.
heuristics.extrapolation: The nominal shares are exact for uniform independent (Y9, omega) (the certificate of proof.md Section 8). If each sampler probability is at most 1.06 times its nominal share, the Chernoff bound of proof.md 10.3 puts each overflow below exp(-RUN_STEPS * share * 53 / 18,020,000): exp(-3.4 * 10^19) for the test-(2) count and exp(-6.2 * 10^17) for the pass count, so their union is far below 0.0005, without independence inside an outer step. Measured (Section 13, untrusted by the harness, Python's generator, whole class): on 60,000,000 real outer steps the two counts are 1.0004 +- 0.0005 (test (2)) and 0.9980 +- 0.0041 (pass) of their nominal values; on another 30,000,000 the pass count is 0.9981 +- 0.0058 of its nominal value.
heuristics.limitations: That each sampler probability is at most 1.06 times its nominal share is not proved: the sampler's Y9 and omega are not proved independent and uniform. The measurements are two runs of one generator made after the design, not a locked validation, and far shorter than this run (about 2^87.46 outer steps). The time bound, the filter and the slots do not depend on these shares.
